{{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox television season | bgcolor = #F1E9D2 | image = dwts7poster.jpg | caption = Promotional poster, featuring former pro dancer [[Edyta Śliwińska]] | module1 = {{Infobox reality competition season | host = {{Plainlist| * [[Tom Bergeron]] * [[Samantha Harris]] }} | judges = {{Plainlist| * [[Carrie Ann Inaba]] * [[Len Goodman]] * [[Bruno Tonioli]] }} | celebrity_winner = [[Brooke Burke Charvet|Brooke Burke]] | professional_winner = [[Derek Hough]] }} | num_episodes = 21 | network = [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] | first_aired = {{start date|2008|9|22}} | last_aired = {{end date|2008|11|25}} }} '''Season seven''' of ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'' premiered on September 22, 2008, on the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] network. Instead of twelve couples as in previous seasons, this was the first season to feature a lineup of thirteen couples. This season also introduced four new dances: the [[Hustle (dance)|hustle]], [[jitterbug]], [[Salsa (dance)|salsa]], and [[West Coast Swing]]. Model and host [[Brooke Burke]] and [[Derek Hough]] were crowned the champions, while [[Tampa Bay Buccaneers]] defensive tackle [[Warren Sapp]] and [[Kym Johnson]] finished in second place, and [[NSYNC]] singer [[Lance Bass]] and [[Lacey Schwimmer]] finished third.{{Cite web |last1=Barrett |first1=Annie |last2= |first2= |date=November 26, 2008 |title=Dancing with the Stars season finale recap: Mama Mia! |url=https://ew.com/recap/dancing-with-the-stars-recap-season-7-episode-21/ |access-date=2022-09-14 |website=EW.com |language=en}} ==Cast== ===Couples=== This season featured thirteen celebrity contestants. Couples are listed in the order they performed. On October 3, [[Misty May-Treanor]] was injured during practice and received immediate medical attention.{{cite web |author=Rizzo, Monica |date=October 4, 2008 |title=DWTS' Misty May-Treanor Injured |url=http://tvwatch.people.com/2008/10/04/dwtss-misty-may-treanor-injured/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081005123816/http://tvwatch.people.com/2008/10/04/dwtss-misty-may-treanor-injured/ |archive-date=October 5, 2008 |access-date=October 5, 2008 |publisher=People.com}} At the end of the episode that aired on Monday, October 6, she announced that she had ruptured her [[Achilles tendon]], and thus had to withdraw from the competition. On the results show the next night, Tom Bergeron revealed that no one would be eliminated that week because of May-Treanor's withdrawal, and the week 3 scores would carry over to week 4.
